notes.title: Introducing our very first playable demo!
notes.notes: [p]We are excited to share that a playable demo is now available![/p][p][/p][p]This demo is designed to give players a taste of how Dokkalfar plays. It begins by equipping you with genre common abilities and a simple loadout, allowing you to dive into the game experience more swiftly.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo map is teeming with enemies, loot, and hidden secrets! You'll find numerous NPCs to engage with and shops stocked with extra abilities to experiment with.[/p][p][/p][p]Our primary inspiration comes from the DS-era Castlevania games, which we believe represent the pinnacle of game design. However, we aimed to modernize these concepts for today’s audience by incorporating numerous quality-of-life improvements, enhanced visuals, and gameplay that values your time. We sincerely hope you enjoy this contemporary classical experience![/p][p][/p][p]That being said, this is just the first of many demos to come. After nearly two years of hard work, we believe the game is finally ready to start gaining support! Currently, this is a fully self-funded project, but we truly need your assistance to demonstrate to publishers that there is a demand for this game! So, please add us to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p]It may sound cliché, but this game is crafted by gamers for gamers, and we genuinely value player feedback. We encourage you to share your thoughts with us as we aim to create an exceptional game![/p][p]We sincerely hope you enjoy everything we've poured into this initial demo and look forward to having you follow us on our development journey![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3443810/Dokkalfar_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: We’re thrilled to share the debut track from our original soundtrack!
notes.notes: [p]We're thrilled to unveil the theme track composed by Vilakshan Kandwal and Abhinav Prajapati for our upcoming game, Dokkalfar: The Ballads of Vivi the Dark Elf, and we can't wait for you to experience this amazing sneak peek of our extraordinary soundtrack![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="v_Nu38g2MYw;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]
